chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about preemption: to whom it belongs, in what things it applies, whether there is preemption in animals, and how it is.

He said: Preemption is obligatory in everything, whether animal, land, or goods, when the property is between two partners and no others, and one of them sells his share; then his partner has more right to it than anyone else. But if they are more than two, then there is no preemption for any one of them.

key_terms.أَرْضٍ: land as a category of jointly owned property
key_terms.الشُّفْعَةِ: the right of preemption in jointly owned property
key_terms.حَيَوَانٍ: animals as a category of property subject to the ruling
key_terms.شَرِيكَيْنِ: two partners jointly owning the property
key_terms.نَصِيبَهُ: his share or portion in the jointly owned property

ai.seo_question: When does the right of shuf'ah apply in shared property according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling of shuf'ah, affirming that it applies to shared property such as animals, land, and goods when ownership is restricted to exactly two partners. If one partner sells his share, the other partner has priority to acquire it, but this right does not apply when the number of partners exceeds two.
